description: A methodology for digitally optimising energy consumption in buildings dataset is a data set deposited in ardcx.wsu by the authors named in the record. Globally, the building sector accounts for 40% of the total energy consumption and directly contributes to climate change. In Australia, the building sector contributes up to 20% of its total energy consumption, thus emphasising the relevance of efficient energy management. Coverage: national (AU); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
